If you’re running an employment agency or employment business in England, Scotland or Wales you must keep proper records on the work-seekers and hirers you do business with.

There are different rules on record keeping for employment agencies and businesses in Northern Ireland.

You must keep the records for set amounts of time and make them easily available to Fair Work Agency (FWA) inspectors.

If an inspector finds you’re breaking the rules they can:

send out warnings

recommend you’re taken to court

seek a prohibition order through an employment tribunal
